rig_style.name: hand-drawn-whole-pose-cel
rig_style.description: All people, plants, fruit, tools, fish and sea creatures are rendered as complete ink-and-pencil cels. drawing_id selects a silhouette; exposure controls its held frame; named anchors remain stable for contacts and attachments.

binding_contract: grip owns the target transform from start until release, including after grip.end. Optional blend_in smooths acquisition in seconds. release captures the evaluated world transform at start; optional offset [dx,dy] in world pixels and spin in degrees move it until end, then it stays there. Re-grip or a new scene resets control. At most 32 grip/release events per scene. Hand-drawn poses may declare drawing_id plus exposure ones/twos/hold; drawing marks stay fixed for that exposure while contacts and root motion remain continuous.
coordinates: Poses use absolute seconds and canvas pixels. Height scales a 100-unit rig; origin is bottom center. Attached actors use pixel offsets from a named parent anchor.
